hover.effect: Move or thicken the existing underline and update the action surface without shifting layout.
hover.reducedMotion: Show the final underline and surface immediately.

press.effect: Change weight and surface immediately; do not bounce or scale.
press.reducedMotion: Show the final weight and surface immediately.

filter.effect: Crossfade the factual result region while keeping its top edge stable.
filter.reducedMotion: Replace results immediately and retain focus.

reveal.trigger: a secondary section first enters the viewport
reveal.effect: Reveal once with opacity and no more than 16px vertical travel.
reveal.reducedMotion: Render the final state immediately with no translation or stagger.

menu.effect: Reveal the full-height sheet as one group; focus moves when the sheet is ready.
menu.reducedMotion: Open and close immediately while preserving focus management.

global.contentBeforeEnhancement: Visible, usable, and in reading order.
global.colorTransition: Signal-red marker transitions are brief; reduced motion removes spatial animation and stagger.
